g.aria-label: P1 cable (JTAG) for a Compute Blade: which wire in which cavity
All 6 wires of the cable are black: a wire's number is its position in the plug, counted from pin 1.
2×5 Dupont housing, seen from the wire side,
as it will sit on the Extension Port with the Compute Blade seen from above.
Numbers in the cavities: as printed beside the Extension Port.
pin 1 = the end nearest the M.2 edge
to a 2×5 Dupont housing on Extension Port pins 1 to 10
wire 6: cut back, heat shrink over the end
3.3 V from the Acorn: it must never reach the host
Mark the pin 1 corner of the housing before filling it.
Turned round, it puts 5 V on a signal wire.
Photos: Uptime Lab (Compute Blade), RHS Research (LiteFury underside; the Acorn is the same PCB)
